suite_rationale: 11/12 cases pass. P1 fails the small-discriminating-evidence requirement due to a broad all-stage measurement request. The suite-level contra criterion otherwise passes: no mechanically repeated family list, bounded C cases remain scoped, L1/L2 generalize, B1/B2 ranking responds to magnitude, and P2 allows positive amplification to dominate. C2 is an explicitly documented marginal pass on implicit product fidelity.
limitations: One semantic evaluation of the first saved answers, not a new model run or answer regeneration.
No runtime, manifests, traces, history or production activation were inspected; evaluation is restricted to frozen key, prompts and the 12 raw answer files.
Rubric screening does not establish universal production reliability or ordinary production activation.
P1 evidence-burden and C2 implicit-fidelity judgments are marginal and fully explained; no nonexistent evidence is treated as a quote.
